text.tspan: fingerprint: neighbouring-pixel correlation
on the raw inputs (seconds of CPU, no training)
near-zero correlation = encoded data
high correlation = image-like data
tight budget? under 35 min skip stages 2, 4, 5;
under 15 min also skip stage 3
image-like -> 2-D TCN directly, no bake-off
(channel-mixing stem if 8 or more channels)
encoded -> gate: train CNN, 1-D TCN and 2-D TCN
briefly at matched wall-clock
adopt the leader only if it clearly beats the CNN,
otherwise default to the CNN
two small networks of the chosen family,
trained briefly: with vs without augmentation
augmentation off (plus mixup) only when OFF wins
by a clear margin: it is regularisation, OFF leads early
depth-4 and depth-8 candidates trained briefly
against the incumbent default depth 6
adopt a candidate only if it beats the incumbent
beyond noise AND survives re-training verification
otherwise: keep depth 6
(skipped for the 1-D TCN)

g.text: runs only on encoded data, only if budget remains

text.tspan: sample 6 random architectures
(11 operation types, depth 3 to 12, width 16 to 48)
adopt only if clearly better than the incumbent,
otherwise discard
the winner trains on ALL remaining time, cosine
learning rate annealed to zero exactly at the budget
